name: IEC mechanical position-switch contact: limit switch normally open - events driven
aliases: mechanical position-switch contact Limit Switch Normally Open - Events Driven
summary: Mechanical position-switch contact form: Limit Switch Normally Open - Events Driven.
description: A mechanically operated position switch changes its contact state when travel, a cam or a lever reaches the documented operating condition. The actuator mark explains how movement reaches the switch; the electrical contact still has to be read in its stated unoperated position. This entry identifies the limit switch normally open - events driven form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

A moving carriage may operate the switch near the end of travel, or an operator may move a multidirectional lever. Identify the actual direction or target position on the drawing and connect the switch tag to the corresponding mechanical detail. The normally-open designation starts with a non-conducting output or open contact in the documented reference condition; operation changes that state. The event-driven actuator qualifier identifies operation by a documented count or event condition, rather than an ordinary travel roller. Reference the actual mechanism and its reset rule.

Detents retain an operating position and are different from a spring-return mechanism. The schematic does not supply operating travel, overtravel, contact force or a safety performance level; use the selected switch data for those properties.
